## Review checklist

### Sources
- [ ] I opened and read every source I cited, on the date in `checked`.
- [ ] New sources are in `data/sources.yml`; changed numbers are in `data/facts.yml`.
- [ ] I checked for newer laws, effective dates, and bills.
- [ ] Unconfirmed items say "Not confirmed"; interpretation says "Our reading."
- [ ] The research memo is updated.

### Words
- [ ] The answer comes first.
- [ ] Grade 8 or lower for changed pages; no new long sentences.
- [ ] No legal advice. No personal case details.

### Checks
- [ ] The "Checks" workflow passes, including browser checks.
- [ ] Keyboard-only and phone-size check of changed pages.

### Records
- [ ] Page `checked` dates, `docs/AUDIT-LOG.md`, and `CHANGELOG.md` updated.
